# EduHorizon - Best Admission Consultancy in India

> EduHorizon is India's trusted college admission consultancy, founded in 2018 and headquartered in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh. We provide free expert guidance to students seeking admissions in top B.Tech, MBA, BCA, MBBS, and other professional courses across 20+ cities in India. We have guided 1000+ students with a 95% admission success rate.

## What We Do

EduHorizon helps students across India find and secure admissions in the right college for their profile, budget, and career goals. Our services are completely free for initial counselling.

### Services Offered
- Free initial counselling and career guidance session (30 minutes)
- Personalised college shortlisting based on marks, budget, and goals
- Comparison of fees, placements, NIRF rankings, and course options
- Application form filling and documentation support
- Direct coordination with college admission offices
- Management quota / direct admission guidance
- Fee negotiation and scholarship guidance
- AKTU / UPSEE / IPU / NEET / JEE counselling support
- Hostel and accommodation guidance for out-of-city students

## Entrance Exams We Support

- JEE Main & Advanced (B.Tech admissions)
- NEET UG (MBBS/Medical admissions)
- CAT / MAT / CMAT / XAT (MBA admissions)
- UPSEE / AKTU state counselling (UP engineering colleges)
- IPU CET (Delhi/IP University admissions)
- CUET (Central University admissions)
- CLAT (Law admissions)
- Bihar DCECE (Bihar engineering)
- BSEB / Bihar state counselling

## Admission Process (Step-by-Step)

**Step 1 — Book Free Counselling**
Call or WhatsApp +91 88774 34088 or fill the online form at https://www.eduhorizon.online/#contact
Our counsellor schedules a free 30-minute session to understand your stream, marks, budget, and career goals.

**Step 2 — College Shortlisting**
Our expert prepares a personalised list comparing fees, NIRF rankings, placement records, and course options based on your profile.

**Step 3 — Application & Documentation**
We help fill application forms and prepare required documents: marksheets, Aadhar card, passport photos, entrance score cards.

**Step 4 — Admission Confirmation**
We coordinate directly with the college admission office to confirm your seat and guide on fee payment until fully secured.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is EduHorizon's counselling service free?**
A: Yes. The initial counselling session and college comparison are completely free. We charge no hidden fees from students.

**Q: How does EduHorizon get direct admissions?**
A: We have direct tie-ups with top colleges' admission offices and management quota seats. This allows us to fast-track admissions for eligible students.

**Q: Which entrance exams do you help with?**
A: JEE (B.Tech), NEET (Medical), CAT/MAT/CMAT (MBA), UPSEE/AKTU (UP state), IPU CET (Delhi), CUET, CLAT (Law), and Bihar DCECE.

**Q: Do you help students from Bihar get NCR admissions?**
A: Yes. We have a dedicated office in Patna and have guided hundreds of Bihar students to top colleges in Noida and Greater Noida.

**Q: What is the minimum marks required for admission?**
A: It varies by college. Many private colleges accept students with 50-60% marks. Contact us with your specific marks for personalised options.

**Q: Do you provide hostel assistance?**
A: Yes, we guide students on hostel availability, cost, and quality at the shortlisted colleges.

**Q: Which is the best college for B.Tech in Greater Noida?**
A: Based on placements and infrastructure: GL Bajaj, Galgotias, Bennett, Sharda, and NIET are top choices. The best fit depends on your budget and branch preference.

**Q: Can you help with management quota admissions?**
A: Yes, we specialize in management quota and direct admission seats across top private colleges in Delhi NCR and UP.
